preconditions.description: The lengths of both strings s and t do not exceed 10^5.
String s consists of lowercase English letters.
String t consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({s[:i] + t[:j] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1) for j in range(1, len(t) + 1)})
postconditions.description: The output is the number of distinct strings that are concatenations of some non-empty prefix of s with some non-empty prefix of t.
